problem:
Given the function $y=2{x}^{3}+x-3{log}_{6}⁡x,$ find the instantaneous rate of change at $x=3.$ Do not round the answer.

The instantaneous rate of change at $x=3$ is
{{field-1}}.

feedback.worked_solution:
To differentiate a logarithm with base $a,$ we use the formula

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({log}_{a}⁡x)=\frac{1}{xln⁡a}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({3}^{x}+log⁡x) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({3}^{x})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(log⁡x) \\  & ={3}^{x}ln⁡(3)+\frac{1}{xln⁡(10)}.\end{aligned}
$$
